prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one isolated Stone Age game building sprite. Attached image 1 (hut) and image 2 (camp scene) are locked style anchors: closely match their fine controlled dark ink contours, sparse interior linework, restrained natural earth-tone wash, two-tone upper-left illumination. Orthographic vertically overhead camera with only a slight front-face cheat, no isometric perspective. Uniform solid pure #FF00FF magenta backdrop everywhere outside the object, including holes. No extraneous surrounding ground apron, cast shadow, text, labels, people, photo, 3D rendering, pixel art, gradients, modern objects, or metal. Center with margin, crisp edges. South is bottom of image. A square roofless 3x3-tile hut, low lashed-log walls, interior packed-earth floor enclosed ONLY within walls, exactly four hide bedrolls and central small stone hearth, clear wide opening through south wall. All interior plainly visible from directly above.
